title: Label-Free Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering Bioanalysis Based on Au@Carbon Dot Nanoprobes
protocol: Prepare CD solution using citric acid and gallic acid via hydrothermal treatment.
Add 100 µL of 3.0 mg mL-1 CD solution into 200 µL of 10 mM chloroauric acid at room temperature for 10 s until a purple suspension is produced.
Centrifuge the purple suspension at 4,000 × g for 10 min at room temperature and gently remove the supernatant using a pipette if necessary.
Resuspend the Au@CDs with 200 µL of deionized water to wash excess CDs.
Repeat step of centrifugation and resuspension with deionized water until no purple color is observed in the supernatant.
Disperse the obtained powder samples into deionized water adequately by sonication at 100% power for 5 min.

Drop a few drops of the sample suspension onto a Cu-coated TEM grid covered with a lacey carbon film and capture images after drying using a transmission electron microscope at a 200 kV acceleration voltage.
Repeat step 2.1.1 to obtain power samples.
Grind pre-dried KBr particles into powders in a mortar.
Add a pinch of the sample to the ground KBr powders.
Mix the sample with the KBr powders simultaneously.
Prepare the suspension of CDs and Au@CDs at proper concentrations.
Perform UV-vis-NIR characterization.
Switch on the 785 nm semiconductor laser.
Set the laser power to 10 mW and objective magnification to 20x.
Set the exposure duration to 5 seconds and accumulations number to three.
Add an equal volume of prepared Au@CDs samples into methylene blue solution.
Thoroughly mix the suspension.
Place a drop of the suspension onto the brass substrate.
Collect SERS spectra.
Culture human epithelial lung carcinoma cells (A549) in Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Incubate the cells in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Seed the cells in 96-well plates (1 × 10^5 cells/well).
Treat the cells with Au@CDs in different concentrations ranging from 20-100 µM.
Use a CCK-8 assay kit to measure cell viability.
Perform three independent duplicates for each treatment.
Put a sterile sapphire chip into the 12-well plates.
Seed cells onto a single well with 1 mL of medium.
Incubate the plates in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 overnight to reach 70%-80% confluence.
Add Au@CDs into the single well and incubate for 4-6 h.
Test the stability of substrates before incubation, especially solution phase NPs.
Observe cells under an optical microscope until a few black particles are seen inside the cells.
Remove the medium from the wells.
Gently rinse the sapphire chips with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Dip the rinsed sapphire chips in PBS for SERS detection.
Open the computer and switch on the Raman spectrometer.
Start the software and switch on the 785 nm laser.
Click on New Measurement to start a new spectral acquisition.
Calibrate with silicon wafers before sample measurement.
Take a 20x objective lens.
Change the objective lens to 50x.
Set the laser power from low to high.
Adjust the appropriate exposure time and accumulations.
Check the appropriate laser power before SERS measurement.
Choose a point of cells to measure.
Click on Run for each cell measured by 20 spots, with 10 cells measured in total.
Take spectra in similar cellular regions and collect as many spectra as possible.
Save the spectra.
Click on New Streamline image acquisition.
Click on Video Review.
Select the range to be photographed.
Click OK.
Set parameters: 785 nm edge streamline, centre of 1,200 cm-1, exposure duration of 5 s, accumulations number of three, and laser power to 50%.
Click on New Living imaging.
Choose Signal to Baseline.
Set the range from first limit 625 to second limit 1,700.
Click on Area setup.
Set proper steps.
Click Apply and OK.
Finally, click Run to start performing SERS imaging.
Dilute overnight cultures of E. coli and S. aureus in 5 mL of new Luria-Bertani (LB) medium.
Grow the diluted cultures at 37 °C until an A600 of 0.4 to 0.6 is reached.
Centrifuge the culture at 5,000 × g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Resuspend the pellets in 1 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge the resuspended pellets again at 5,000 × g for 5 min (at room temperature).
Mix the bacterial culture with Au@CDs.
Observe the mixture directly under the SERS platform.
